card.name: Middle of compound names and phrases
card.fires_on: The middle or second part of a compound name or phrase, such as the 'water' in Freshwater Research Centre or 'all' in Wallpolla. It is strongest in Murray-Darling river-science text.

modes.label: Murray-Darling place and institute names
modes.description: The 'water' or 'Fresh' piece inside Freshwater Research Centre, and parts of place names like Wallpolla.
modes.example: Cherie Campbell, Murray-Darling Fresh<<water>> Research Centre, Mildura Abund

modes.label: Other split compounds
modes.description: Pieces inside hyphenated or split words, such as Shire-folk or gay/lesbian.
modes.example: rally the Shire<<-f>>olk against the invaders.
